payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the layer norm approximation has a significant negative impact on performance, particularly in the context of the tasks discussed in the paper.

claims.text: The layer norm approximation incurs the most performance reduction, averaging 1.08% compared to the baseline model.
Jointly finetuning the softmax estimation model and approximated layernorm leads to a performance drop of 0.4% in the regression task STS-B.
The approximation method yields poor performance without regularization, indicating the importance of managing attention scores for effective layer normalization.
